name: Spotlite
description:
A macOS-style Spotlight for GNOME. Press Super+Space and type: apps, files, sums, the meaning of a word, a Wikipedia topic or a web search, all without opening a browser. Select a result and press Space for a Quick Look card with the details; Esc closes it.

It also answers questions directly: “age of rihanna”, “capital of france”, “weather in paris”.

Online lookups send what you type to wikipedia.org and wikidata.org (articles and facts), wiktionary.org and dictionaryapi.dev (definitions) and open-meteo.com (weather); wolframalpha.com only if you add your own AppID. Each can be turned off in the preferences.
